articles.title: Churches Shouldn’t Just Ban Hillsong, Bethel, and Elevation
articles.summary: I’ve been leading worship for 15 years. For the past 10, I’ve served as a contract leader for multiple congregations throughout Texas. And increasingly, I’ve encountered churches all across denominational lines taking a strong position: They won’t sing songs written by the worship behemoths Hillsong, Bethel, or Elevation. Anecdotally, I haven’t encountered much nuance in  Read more...   The post  Churches Shouldn’t Just Ban Hillsong, Bethel, and Elevation  appeared first on  Christianity Today .
articles.summary_zh: 我带领敬拜已经15年了。在过去的10年里，我曾担任德州多个教会的签约领唱。我越来越频繁地遇到跨越宗派界限的教会采取强硬立场：他们不愿演唱由敬拜巨头Hillsong、Bethel或Elevation创作的歌曲。据我所知，我没有遇到过太多细微差别。阅读更多……这篇文章《教会不应只禁止颂恩堂、伯特利和高地教会》最初发表在《今日基督教》上。
articles.title_zh: 教会不应只禁止颂恩堂（Hillsong）、伯特利（Bethel）和高地（Elevation）教会
articles.author: Kenny Klinglesmith

articles.title: Christianity Today for the Next Generation
articles.summary: “Nobody in my church or my family talks about hard things. It’s always too political or too contentious.” We sat at a table in the back room of Asbury University’s student cafeteria. Four bold, confident college women talked with me about their academic plans, their excitement and trepidation about graduation, and their honest views of  Read more...   The post  Christianity Today for the Next Generation  appeared first on  Christianity Today .
articles.summary_zh: “我所在的教会和我的家人都不谈论棘手的问题。这些话题总是过于政治化或过于有争议。” 我们坐在阿斯伯里大学学生食堂后厅的一张桌子旁。四位勇敢自信的大学生女生与我聊了她们的学习计划、对毕业的兴奋与忐忑，以及她们对……的坦诚看法。阅读更多……这篇题为《面向下一代的今日基督教》的文章最初发表在《今日基督教》上。
articles.title_zh: 面向下一代的今日基督教
articles.author: Nicole Massie Martin

articles.title: Pollster warns Trump lost young men over affordability, war: 'They're done'
articles.summary: Rich Baris, a prominent state and national pollster who predicted a Republican midterm rout, claimed that a majority of young men who formerly supported President Donald Trump are angry at Israeli influence in U.S. politics and punished him for it in the midterm election.
articles.summary_zh: 知名州级和国家级民意调查专家里奇·巴里斯（Rich Baris）曾预测共和党在中期选举中将遭遇惨败。他声称，此前支持唐纳德·特朗普总统的大多数年轻男性对以色列在美国政坛的影响感到愤怒，并在中期选举中以此为由惩罚了特朗普。
articles.title_zh: 民意调查员警告称，特朗普因住房负担能力和战争问题失去了年轻男性选民的支持：“他们已经不再支持他了。”
articles.author: Jon Brown

articles.title: Wes Huff gives update on 3-year-old daughter’s condition after hospitalization for multiple seizures
articles.summary: Canadian apologist Wes Huff has announced that his 3-year-old daughter has returned home after spending two nights in the hospital following a series of seizures.
articles.summary_zh: 加拿大护教士韦斯·赫夫（Wes Huff）宣布，他的3岁女儿在经历一系列癫痫发作后，在医院度过两晚，现已返回家中。
articles.title_zh: Wes Huff介绍了3岁女儿因多次癫痫发作住院后的最新情况
articles.author: Ryan Foley

articles.title: Low-income households more likely to give at least 10% of their earnings to churches, charities: study
articles.summary: American households making less than $30,000 a year are nearly twice as likely as those making over $100,000 a year to donate at least 10% of their incomes to churches or charities, according to a new study suggesting that giving patterns remain closely tied to religious belief and practice.
articles.summary_zh: 一项新研究表明，捐赠模式与宗教信仰和宗教活动密切相关。根据该研究，年收入低于3万美元的美国家庭将至少10%的收入捐赠给教会或慈善机构的可能性，几乎是年收入超过10万美元的家庭的两倍。
articles.title_zh: 研究表明，低收入家庭更有可能将其收入的至少10%捐赠给教会和慈善机构
articles.author: Ryan Foley

articles.title: TGC contributing pastors clash over whether spouses should sit together at church
articles.summary: The Gospel Coalition (TGC) appeared to reverse course Thursday after an article published on its U.S. and Australian sites suggested married couples should stop sitting together at church.
articles.summary_zh: 福音联盟（TGC）周四似乎改变了立场，此前其美国和澳大利亚网站上发表的一篇文章建议已婚夫妇不要在教堂里坐在一起。
articles.title_zh: TGC撰稿牧师就配偶是否应在教会中同坐一处发生争执
articles.author: Ian M. Giatti

articles.title: Gazan Christians reveal horrors amid crackdown under Hamas rule: 'You cannot forget about us'
articles.summary: A Gazan Christian reflected on how life changed after Hamas seized control of the Gaza Strip in 2007, as recent reports indicate that the region's Christian community has dwindled to just a few hundred people.
articles.summary_zh: 一名加沙基督徒回顾了哈马斯于2007年夺取加沙地带的控制权后生活发生的巨变，而近期有报道称，该地区的基督徒群体已萎缩至仅剩数百人。
articles.title_zh: 加沙的基督徒揭露了在哈马斯统治下的镇压所带来的恐怖：“你们不能忘记我们”
articles.author: Samantha Kamman

articles.title: Iraq urges Christians driven out by ISIS to return as new cathedral opens
articles.summary: Iraq’s Christians received a message of hope this week when a Coptic Orthodox cathedral opened in Baghdad, with officials urging Christians who had left to come home.
articles.summary_zh: 本周，随着科普特东正教堂在巴格达落成，伊拉克的基督徒收到了希望的信息，官员们敦促离开的基督徒回家。

articles.title: Wes Huff addresses plagiarism allegations amid review: 'Honesty and integrity matter'
articles.summary: Popular Christian apologist Wes Huff addressed accusations of plagiarism against him Friday and noted that his affiliated ministry is conducting a review after he took down his website and removed videos from his YouTube channel.
articles.summary_zh: 知名基督教护教学家韦斯·赫夫（Wes Huff）周五回应了针对他的剽窃指控，并指出，在他关闭了自己的网站并从其YouTube频道删除了视频后，他所属的教会正在进行审查。
articles.title_zh: Wes Huff在审查期间回应剽窃指控：“诚实和诚信至关重要”

articles.title: Christian singer Steve Camp, author of '107 Theses' calling for CCM reform, dies at 71
articles.summary: Contemporary Christian music singer Steve Camp, who spent years trying to reform the industry behind the genre, has died at 71.

articles.title_zh: 呼吁当代基督教音乐（CCM）改革的《107条论纲》作者、基督教歌手史蒂夫·坎普（Steve Camp）去世，享年71岁

articles.summary: Jonathan Allen Wright, creator of the YouTube documentary series "The Untold History of CCM," joins The Christian Post to discuss the complicated business behind contemporary Christian music

articles.title_zh: 基督教音乐鲜为人知的故事：是谁掌控着我们所唱的敬拜歌曲？

articles.title: Have you settled? What a chicken plant taught me about purpose
articles.summary: “I settled.” Those two words, spoken by a coworker on the night shift at a chicken plant, became a warning I couldn’t ignore and a turning point in how I think about purpose, comfort and faith.
articles.summary_zh: “我认命了。”这句话出自一位在鸡肉加工厂上夜班的同事之口，它成了我无法忽视的警示，也成了我思考人生目标、安逸和信仰的转折点。
articles.title_zh: 你安顿下来了吗？一家养鸡场教会了我什么是目标
articles.author: Benjamin Windle

articles.title: Trump won’t forgive his enemies. Can any of us?
articles.summary: Asked by Ross Douthat whether he could forgive his enemies in order to enter paradise, President Trump said no, and admitted he hates some of them. At least he was honest about something most of us only hide. The Gospel explains why forgiveness is so hard and where the power to forgive comes from.
articles.summary_zh: 当罗斯·杜哈特（Ross Douthat）问特朗普总统是否能为了进入天堂而宽恕敌人时，他回答说不能，并承认他憎恨其中一些人。至少他坦诚面对了我们大多数人只会掩藏的事情。福音书解释了为什么宽恕如此之难，以及宽恕的力量来自何方。
articles.title_zh: 特朗普不会原谅他的敌人。我们当中有谁能做到吗？
articles.author: John Stonestreet

articles.title: Midterm elections: Bad, but not fatal for the Republic
articles.summary: The days since the midterms feel like arriving at a crime scene. Everyone saw the same event, but some are angry, some are afraid, and some are confused. The job is to stay calm, establish the facts, and prepare for the next call.
articles.summary_zh: 中期选举以来的日子感觉就像来到了犯罪现场。每个人都目睹了同一事件，但有人愤怒，有人害怕，有人困惑。我们的任务是保持冷静，查明事实，并为下一次行动做好准备。
articles.title_zh: 中期选举：糟糕，但对共和党来说并非致命

articles.title: Progressive Christians won big: The culture war’s new front
articles.summary: The November midterms sent a wave of progressive Christian clergy and lay leaders into office. Their concern for the poor and marginalized deserves a serious hearing. Their theology raises a harder question: is it consistent with historic biblical Christianity?
articles.summary_zh: 11月的中期选举让一批进步派基督教神职人员和俗家领袖当选。他们对穷人和边缘群体的关切值得认真听取。他们的神学提出了一个更棘手的问题：它是否与历史上的圣经基督教相一致？
articles.title_zh: 进步派基督徒大获全胜：文化战争的新前线
articles.author: Mark Creech

articles.title_zh: 旅游：圣路易斯是一座被低估的美国大都市

articles.summary: The United Nations General Assembly has renewed Iran’s seat on its Committee for Programme and Coordination, which sets priorities on counterterrorism, women’s rights and disarmament, drawing criticism of the Iranian government’s human rights record from Canada, Australia and a rights watchdog.
articles.summary_zh: 联合国大会已恢复伊朗在方案和协调委员会的席位，该委员会将反恐、妇女权利和裁军列为优先事项，这引发了加拿大、澳大利亚和一家人权观察组织对伊朗政府人权记录的批评。

articles.title: Jim Caviezel claims Jesus physically appeared, convinced him to star in 'The Passion of the Christ'
articles.summary: Actor Jim Caviezel recently claimed that Jesus Christ physically appeared to him more than 20 years ago as he was considering whether to take the starring role in "The Passion of the Christ," Mel Gibson's 2004 film depicting the Crucifixion.
articles.summary_zh: 演员吉姆·卡维泽（Jim Caviezel）最近声称，20多年前，当他在考虑是否出演梅尔·吉布森（Mel Gibson）2004年描绘耶稣受难的电影《耶稣受难记》（The Passion of the Christ）时，耶稣基督曾亲自向他显现。
articles.title_zh: 吉姆·卡维泽声称耶稣曾亲自显灵，说服他出演《耶稣受难记》。

articles.title: 'Get out of our country, Jew': Protesters target Jewish-owned restaurants in Philly
articles.summary: Anti-Israel protesters organized a boycott bike ride in Philadelphia and protested several Jewish businesses on the eve of the 88th anniversary of Kristallnacht.

articles.title_zh: “滚出我们的国家，犹太人”：抗议者在费城针对犹太人开的餐厅

articles.title: She watched poverty destroy dreams in Haiti. Then she fought back
articles.summary: Imagine being forced out of school because your family couldn't afford just $1. For Miquette McMahon, that was reality growing up in poverty-stricken Haiti. But God had a bigger plan for her life.
articles.summary_zh: 想象一下，由于您的家人负担不起$ 1 ，他们被迫辍学。对于米凯特·麦克马洪（ Miquette McMahon ）来说，这是在贫困的海地长大的现实。但上帝对她的人生有一个更大的计划。
articles.title_zh: 她眼睁睁地看着贫穷摧毁了海地的梦想。然后她反击了
articles.author: Billy Hallowell

articles.title: Actor, comedian Katt Williams says he isn't religious but roots his self-worth in God
articles.summary: Despite growing up in a household where he was physically abused as a child by his parents, comedian Katt Williams says his personal relationship with God has evolved into an independent nondenominational practice without affiliation with any particular religion.
articles.summary_zh: 尽管喜剧演员卡特·威廉姆斯（Katt Williams）从小在父母的虐待中长大，但他表示，自己与上帝的个人关系已发展成为一种独立的非宗派信仰，不隶属于任何特定宗教。
articles.title_zh: 演员兼喜剧演员卡特·威廉姆斯表示，他不是信教之人，但他将自我价值的根基建立在上帝之上。
articles.author: Leonardo Blair

articles.title: Talarico gets more votes than Hillary, Kamala: 4 midterm election shockers in Texas
articles.summary: While Republicans were roundly defeated by Democrats across the country in last week's midterms, it was Democrat James Talarico’s dramatic defeat of Republican Ken Paxton that encapsulated the scope of the “blue wave” that saw dozens of U.S. House of Representatives districts and at least seven U.S. Senate seats flip to Democrats.
articles.summary_zh: 虽然在两周前的中期选举中，共和党人在全国范围内被民主党人彻底击败，但民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科（James Talarico）对共和党人肯·帕克斯顿（Ken Paxton）的戏剧性胜利，体现了“蓝色浪潮”的规模，这场浪潮使数十个美国众议院选区和至少七个美国参议院席位落入民主党人之手。
articles.title_zh: 塔拉里科的得票数超过希拉里和卡马拉：德克萨斯州中期选举的4大意外结果

articles.title: Wife of Sovereign Grace Music's Bob Kauflin dies suddenly during date night
articles.summary: Pastor Bob Kauflin revealed that the sudden death of his wife, Julie Kauflin, has brought him waves of tears and an ache unlike anything he has experienced, but he is seeking comfort in the knowledge that he will one day see her again in heaven.
articles.summary_zh: 鲍勃·考夫林牧师透露，妻子朱莉·考夫林（Julie Kauflin）的突然离世让他泪流不止，并带来了前所未有的痛苦，但他正从这样一个认识中寻求安慰：有一天他会在天堂与她重逢。
articles.title_zh: 主权恩典音乐事工（Sovereign Grace Music）的鲍勃·考夫林（Bob Kauflin）的妻子在约会之夜突然去世
articles.author: Samantha Kamman

articles.title: Florida's Transformation Church shuts down satellite campus months after merger: 'Hard decision'

articles.title_zh: 佛罗里达州转化教会（Transformation Church）在合并数月后关闭卫星分堂：“艰难的决定”

articles.title: The GOP’s midterm losses aren’t apocalyptic. Here’s proof.
articles.summary: The midterm elections are over, and the GOP suffered stunning setbacks. But Christians know that in the end, Christ is King and Christ is Victor, no matter what temporary setbacks come along the way.
articles.summary_zh: 中期选举已经结束，共和党遭遇了令人震惊的挫败。但基督徒知道，无论在前进的道路上遇到怎样的暂时挫折，最终基督是王，基督是胜利者。
articles.title_zh: 共和党在中期选举中的失利并非灾难性的。以下是证据。
articles.author: Richard D. Land

articles.title: Dozens of lawmakers urge House leaders to invite Pope Leo XIV to speak to Congress
articles.summary: Dozens of lawmakers on both sides of the aisle are urging the leaders of the U.S. House of Representatives to invite Pope Leo XIV to speak to a joint session of the U.S. Congress next year. articles.summary_zh: Love Story Church的牧师约翰·格雷（John Gray）表示，美国“不是一个基督教国家”，并在对2022年中期选举进行激情洋溢的“事后分析”时，告诫他在南卡罗来纳州格林维尔的会众不要将他们的属灵身份与政治混为一谈。
articles.title_zh: 约翰·格雷牧师在中期选举的“事后分析”中宣称美国“不是一个基督教国家”
articles.author: Leonardo Blair

articles.title: Jimmy Stewart's daughter reveals hidden struggles behind 'It's a Wonderful Life': 'He never talked about the war'
articles.summary: For decades, Kelly Stewart Harcourt knew her father, legendary Hollywood actor James Stewart, as a devoted family man whose integrity and faith defined his life. But after his death, the discovery of a wartime diary revealed a side of the “It’s a Wonderful Life” actor that even his own daughters had never fully understood.
articles.summary_zh: 几十年来，凯莉·斯图尔特·哈考特眼中的父亲——传奇好莱坞演员詹姆斯·斯图尔特——是一位忠于家庭的男人，他的诚信和信仰是他一生的写照。然而，在他去世后，人们发现了一本日记，其中记录了他战时的生活。这本日记揭示了这位《风云人物》主演的一面，就连他的女儿们也从未完全了解过。
articles.title_zh: 吉米·斯图尔特的女儿揭示了《美好人生》背后的隐秘挣扎：“他从未谈论过战争”
articles.author: Leah MarieAnn Klett

articles.summary: Ahead of the Christmas season, “Sound of Freedom” filmmaker Alejandro Monteverde is exploring the birth of Jesus Christ through a new lens in “Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ,” a biblical epic that explores the danger and extraordinary faith surrounding the Nativity.
